home.title:

home.lede: Meridian connects POS software and kiosks to every payment provider in Europe. The merchant keeps their PSP, you keep the sale, and no payment is ever charged twice, even during an outage.
ui.title: Payments · today
compat.h: Works with Europe's POS standards and local payment methods
doors.sw.h: Never lose a sale because of the merchant's PSP.
doors.sw.p: One SDK, five calls, every PSP in the catalogue. Your Concert, ZVT or nexo terminals keep working without a rewrite.
doors.psp.h: Be in every till, without one more integration.
doors.psp.p: Publish a module once; it becomes available to every connected vendor. You keep the contract, KYC, funds and fees.
stats.h: Guarantees that are tested, not promised.
stats.k1: API calls for the whole catalogue
stats.k2: failure scenarios checked on every release
stats.k3: double charges across 200 random failure sequences
stats.note: Results from the open test suite, run against PSP simulators faithful to their APIs. Validation on live sandboxes in progress.
how.h: One simple rule: write before you act.
how.s1.p: A single “pay” call, whatever PSP sits behind it. Same reference, same result, even if the request is sent twice.
how.s2.p: Each step is recorded in a chained, signed journal before it reaches the PSP, with one idempotency key per step.
how.s3.h: The outcome is guaranteed and provable
how.s3.p: If anything drops, Meridian resumes from the journal and recovers the real outcome. Every payment ends with a verifiable proof.
guar.r1.b: Keeps the payment “in progress”, never “failed”, and queries the PSP
guar.r2.b: Replays with the same idempotency key
guar.r3.b: Another instance resumes from the shared journal
guar.r4.b: Fails over to the backup PSP, only if nothing was sent
guar.r5.b: Returns the real outcome and allows a refund
ind.h: Wherever people pay, with or without a cashier.
ind.1.p: Ordering kiosks and tills, one connection for every franchised brand.
ind.2.p: The merchant keeps their PSP; the vendor keeps the sale.
ind.3.p: Remote terminals, unstable networks: guaranteed recovery makes the difference.
ind.4.p: Pre-authorisation, final amount, proof for every session.
ind.5.p: Several countries, several PSPs, a single integration.
ind.6.p: Small amounts, high volumes, zero double-charge disputes.
neutral.h: The PSP keeps the contract, KYC, funds and fees. Meridian never touches the money.
neutral.p: A neutral technical layer: no PSP owns it, none is promoted. The merchant keeps the choice.
close.h: Watch Meridian handle an outage live, in 30 seconds.
sw.eyebrow: For POS and kiosk software vendors
sw.title: Never lose a sale because of the merchant's PSP.
sw.lede: Every merchant comes with their own PSP. Every PSP costs an integration, a certification and ongoing maintenance. With Meridian you integrate once and offer the whole catalogue.
sw.api.p: Pay, check status, cancel, refund, get the receipt. The SDK handles retries, timeouts and lost responses. Your code never knows which PSP is behind it.
sw.proto.h: Your existing terminals work as they are.
sw.proto.same: Nothing: point the till at Meridian
sw.cov.h: Local payment methods, country by country.
sw.cta.h: Connect your till in the sandbox.
psp.title: Be in every till, without one more integration.
psp.lede: To reach a merchant you must be integrated into their till, vendor by vendor, country by country. Meridian gets you there in one go, without touching your customer relationship.
psp.keep.h: You keep everything. We are just the cable.
psp.mod.h: A declarative module, not a project.
psp.mod.p: You describe your API in one file: steps, idempotency keys, status lookup, decline codes. No code in the engine. A module is rejected if it cannot guarantee idempotency.
psp.conf.p: Your module runs the eight failure scenarios against your sandbox: lost response, network drop, crash, late cancellation. The report is the condition for publication.

demo.lede: Pick a failure. Meridian runs a real €24.50 payment, the failure is injected mid-operation, and you see the journal, the number of charges and the proof.

ft.p: Neutral payment connector for tills and kiosks. Europe.
ft.legal: Meridian is a technical service provider: it holds no funds, signs no contracts with merchants and stores no full card numbers. Payments are executed by the PSPs chosen by merchants. Demonstration version; results obtained on PSP simulators.
